Devotees throng temples for first Monday of Sawan month

Thousands of devotees visited Shiva temples across India to observe the first Monday of the Sawan month. In Banka, a 'Kanwar Shobha Yatra' procession was taken out. Reports from Ujjain's Mahakal temple and other locations described large crowds participating in prayers and rituals. Some outlets also provided guidance on observing the Sawan Monday fast and rituals, including information on auspicious timings for the Mangla Gauri fast.
